Unbroken March.name: Unbroken March
Unbroken March.description: The user's signature move: the body heals as fast as it is hurt, and the user walks straight at a single target in sight. Attacks still wound them, but nothing short of a solid wall stops or slows them, and on arrival they seize the target, who cannot move until they break free with a hard effort or the user lets go; afterward the user cannot use the Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.
